concerns.text: T012 (Log parser), T013 (Filter logic), and T014 (Hint purity) are all assigned to the same file `code/utils/extraction.py` but marked [P] (parallel). This violates the 'Producer before consumer' and 'Parallel-safe' rules: T013 and T014 logically depend on the parser (T012) to exist before they can be implemented or tested. They cannot run in parallel as they share the same file and sequential logic dependencies.

T019 (Model init), T020 (Training loop), T021 (Data loading), T022 (CUDA check), T023 (Save weights), and T024 (Logging) are all assigned to `code/models/train_distilled.py` and marked [P]. This is a semantic ordering violation: T020 depends on T019, T021 must be integrated before T020 runs, and T023 depends on T020 completion. These cannot be implemented in parallel within a single file.

T026 (Load tasks), T027 (Distilled run), T028 (Baseline run), T029 (Ablation run), T030 (Metrics), T031 (Stats), T032 (Power), T033 (Report) are split across `code/data/evaluation/`, `code/models/eval.py`, and `code/utils/metrics.py`. T027, T028, and T029 are marked [P] but all depend on T026 (task loading) and the model from US2. While the *execution* of runs can be parallel, the *implementation* tasks in a single file (`eval.py`) cannot be developed in parallel without conflict. Furthermore, T030 (Metrics) depends on the output of T027-T029, so marking T030 as [P] alongside the runners is semantically incorrect for implementation ordering.

T034 (Sensitivity sweep) is marked [P] but depends on the execution logic of T027-T029 (from US3) and the metrics logic of T030. T035 (Variance calc) depends on T034. T037 (Ablation Report) depends on T029. T038 (Stress Test) depends on T027. These tasks are marked [P] but have clear sequential dependencies on US3 outputs and internal logic, making the parallel tag misleading for implementation ordering.

T015 (Download script) is marked [P] but logically must precede T012 (Log parser) which consumes the downloaded data. While the file paths differ, the data-flow dependency (Producer: Download -> Consumer: Parse) suggests T015 should be strictly ordered before T012, not just grouped in the same phase. The current grouping implies they can start simultaneously, which is impossible without the data.
